# Stakeholder Map — Simple React Todo App

## Sources

- [Q2] Customer: individual end users managing their own personal tasks.
- [Q5] Decision-maker: the developer alone decides scope and priorities.
- [Q6] Communication: informal, no reporting needed.

## Key Stakeholders and Interests

| Stakeholder | Interest | Source |
|-------------|----------|--------|
| Individual end user | Reliably capturing, completing, and removing their own personal tasks | [Q2] |
| Developer (also the owner) | Deciding scope and priorities; building the app to meet the personal need | [Q5] |

## Decision-Makers vs. Influencers

| Role | Type | Notes | Source |
|------|------|-------|--------|
| Developer | Decision-maker | Sole authority over scope and priority | [Q5] |
| Individual end user | Influencer | The end user's needs shape what is built; in this initiative the developer and end user needs are aligned under one person | [Q2] [Q5] |

## Communication Requirements

| Requirement | Detail | Source |
|-------------|--------|--------|
| Reporting cadence | None — informal, no reporting needed | [Q6] |

## Assumptions & Open Questions

None.
